label: s1_sub_003_woman_01
text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_02
text: Oh, the positive energy is positively flowing!\nI’d just love to buy up all this Kitakami air![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_01
text: That’s my dearest O’Nare! Even while out in the\nboonies, your ideas are still purely metropolitan![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_03
text: I do appreciate your willingness to speak\nthe truth, Billy![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_02
text: So, my dearest O’Nare! However shall we waste\nour time and our money today?[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_04
text: How, indeed...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_05
text: Billy, look—a commoner! They’re staring at us...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_03
text: Eh? A commoner?[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_04
text: Why yes, your eyes do not decieve you—that\nthere is almost certainly a commoner![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_06
text: As I live and breathe—a commoner! A living,\nbreathing commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_07
text: Wh-whatever do we do, Billy?! Is it bad manners\nto ask to shake their hand? Is it acceptable to\r\nask for an autograph?![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_05
text: Collect yourself, my dear O’Nare! No need to\nrush. Look! This commoner isn’t going anywhere![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_08
text: My apologies... It’s not every day that I come\nface-to-face with a commoner, you see.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_06
text: Naturally—you’re the president of Paldea Realty,\nafter all![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_09
text: Excuse me? Yes, you—commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_10
text: Would you be so kind as to indulge me in a duel\nwith your Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_11
text: If you can defeat me, I will grant you riches\nbeyond your wildest imagination![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_07
text: Th-there it is! O’Nare’s favorite pastime—[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_11
text: throwing the common folk a bone![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_12
text: Ohoho... Please come see me once you’re ready,\ndear commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_npc
text: If you want the great fortune O’Nare offered,\nyou should go speak to her, dear commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_13
text: Will you duel me for riches beyond your wildest\nimagination?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_14
text:
You know, I think I quite like it when a commoner
tells me no now and then...\c
But the time of a Glitterati is exceedingly
valuable! We will have this battle RIGHT NOW![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_15
text: I, O’Nare—the president of Paldea Realty—will\ncrush you, commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_08
text: Pfwee, pfwee! Go get ’em, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_16
text: You’re really something! A commoner a cut\nabove the rest![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_09
text: Pfwee, pfwee! Not even defeat can eclipse your\nbeauty, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_17
text: Now listen to me, commoner: the most important\nthing about money is how you use it.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_18
text: Spend that reward on something meaningful—an\ninvestment in yourself.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_19
text: That way, you’ll continue to sparkle, even when\nyour money is gone![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_woman_20
text: Come now, dear Billy! I think I’d quite like to go\nsee [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]that waterfall[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_003_man_10
text: Pfwee! We’ve only just arrived in Kitakami, yet\nnow we’re returning home! You really are an\r\nexemplary Glitterati![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_003_secretary_01
text: Oh, my dear Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare... Where\nin the world are you?

label: s1_sub_003_secretary_02
text: Lady O’Nare said something about a place with a\nview of the bountiful fields of the countryside...\r\nbut where is that?
